label: early copy steps (recall 1-3) where q/y/a is being output or q/b/y is coming up
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original or delimiter steps. About 93% of activation mass falls on recall_idx 1-3 (the 2nd-4th outputs), and it fires more on short sequences (L=4-6). Within that window magnitude depends on which tokens are being output now or soon: rates are highest when out_tok is q (8x lift), y (6.6x) or a (5.2x), or when the next output is q, b or y. The strongest examples are early copy steps where the output is q/y/a followed by q and then b, e.g. f q q q b u. It is weak or silent once recall_idx >= 4 and on early copy steps whose upcoming tokens do not include these letters. The token dependence is graded over many letters, not a clean set, so precision (~0.39) and recall (~0.57) stay low; dev F1 0.46, mass recall 0.71.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: q, y, a, s, l, 0; least: 2, k, -, o) and the next token to output (most: q, b, y, a, 0, g; least: n, f, o, r); timing cues that raise it most: phase=2, recall_idx=2, recall_idx=1.
